og:description: FPV, virtual tours, film, and the page that takes the lead. One studio for Bali developers and operators running overlapping launches.

mainEntity.name: What does a developer launch include?

acceptedAnswer.text: The open offer is virtual tour, FPV walkthrough, aerial footage, a sales-oriented property film, and short-form social assets. The landing page and tracking sit in the same brief when the project needs a place for the lead to land.

mainEntity.name: How does pricing work?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Immersive Property Launch has a published reference price of IDR 25,000,000 for one launch system. Scope can change it. Ongoing work across overlapping sites is quoted after a review. We do not invent a monthly number before we have seen the sites.

mainEntity.name: Can you run more than one site at a time?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. That is the usual shape of a developer brief. Capture is planned so overlapping launches still share a look. We take the work we can keep consistent. We do not stack sites until the look breaks.

mainEntity.name: Do you work outside Bali?

acceptedAnswer.text: The studio is in Kerobokan. Selected work includes Nusa Penida, East Nusa Tenggara, and Koh Samui. Permits and access are confirmed before we fly.

mainEntity.name: What if the building is not finished?

acceptedAnswer.text: That is a normal brief. We tour from the site as it stands, and from 3D renders when the rooms do not exist yet. A buyer should still recognise the place when they arrive.

mainEntity.name: What happens after the first cut?

acceptedAnswer.text: You review the cuts and the tour before anything is treated as final. Changes that stay inside the agreed brief are part of delivery. A new site, a new story, or a second launch is a new scope.

mainEntity.name: Do we have to manage the production?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Send the brief. We answer on WhatsApp. Reviews happen on the cuts and tours, not on a call for every frame. You should not need to run three suppliers to get a film, a walkthrough, and a page.
